name: plasma-same-session-computer-use
description: Parallel exact KWin capture with per-window ownership and recoverable global-seat leases for Plasma Wayland.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel capture and agent-safe coordination for Plasma.
interface.longDescription: Extends Computer Use on Plasma Wayland with stable KWin window IDs, parallel compositor-side capture, cross-process expiring per-window claims, and owner-bound focus/restoration leases. The broker serializes its one global-seat lane but cannot gate a separate global-input tool.
defaultPrompt: Use multiple agents on different existing Plasma windows in parallel.
Claim and capture exact KWin windows without changing my desktop.
Coordinate shared-seat fallback input with recoverable owner-bound leases.
